features.name: platform_1_indicator
features.description: Indicator for rows with platform_id equal to 1.0, giving the model a direct venue-specific offset.
features.expected_model_benefit: Allows a linear SVM margin to account for platform-specific market mechanics without imposing a numeric ordering across all venues.

features.name: platform_3_indicator
features.description: Indicator for rows with platform_id equal to 3.0, with platform_id equal to 2.0 left as the reference through the intercept.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a stable sparse platform adjustment that can shift the linear margin for venue-level effects.

features.name: open_level_z_clipped
features.description: Open price standardized with fixed training-fold mean and scale, then clipped to bound leverage from edge prices.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a smooth bounded price-level coordinate that is well suited to linear margin weighting.

features.name: midpoint_level_z_clipped
features.description: Average of high and low standardized with fixed training-fold center and scale, then clipped for robustness.
features.expected_model_benefit: Supplies a stable central price coordinate that complements the open value for a linear SVM.

features.name: intraperiod_span_clipped
features.description: Clipped difference between high and low, representing observed price movement width within the row.
features.expected_model_benefit: Gives the linear margin a direct continuous severity measure for within-row price dispersion.

features.name: open_range_position
features.description: Open price position within the observed high-low interval, stabilized with a small denominator floor.
features.expected_model_benefit: Converts price shape into a normalized coordinate that lets a linear SVM detect edge-position effects.

features.name: upper_excursion_from_open
features.description: Clipped amount by which high exceeds open, measuring upward excursion magnitude within the row.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds an interpretable directional movement component that can be combined linearly with the open and span features.

features.name: lower_excursion_from_open
features.description: Clipped amount by which open exceeds low, measuring downward excursion magnitude within the row.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides the complementary movement component needed for a linear margin to represent asymmetric price paths.

features.name: log_volume_scaled
features.description: Log-transformed volume scaled by the fixed training-fold maximum volume and clipped to a unit interval.
features.expected_model_benefit: Compresses heavy-tailed liquidity into a smooth bounded score that is easier for a linear SVM to weight.

features.name: log_trade_count_scaled
features.description: Log-transformed trade_count scaled by the fixed training-fold maximum trade count and clipped to a unit interval.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures participation intensity on a normalized scale, reducing the influence of extreme activity counts.

features.name: log_avg_trade_size_scaled
features.description: Smoothed average volume per trade, log-transformed and scaled to reduce block-trade skew.
features.expected_model_benefit: Separates trade size intensity from raw activity count, giving the linear margin another liquidity dimension.

features.name: semantic_market_quality_score
features.description: A 0 to 1 assessor score based only on the row values: higher when price span, open placement, volume, and trade_count appear mutually consistent; lower when activity is sparse, blocky, or price movement appears erratic.
features.expected_model_benefit: Compresses cross-field consistency into a single smooth score that a linear SVM can weight directly.
